name: Ankheg
senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11

traits.name: Damage Transfer.
traits.text: When the ankheg takes acid damage, it deals 7 (2d6) acid damage back to the attacker (reaction).

actions.name: Bite.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharges 5-6).
actions.text: The ankheg sprays acid in a 30-ft. cone. DC 13 DEX save or 21 (6d6) acid damage; success: half.
